label: DATING AGAIN

points.heading: Lead with a real smile
points.body: A clear, recent photo where you look relaxed and happy.
points.panel: Ask a friend which photo looks most like you on a good day.

points.heading: Show your life
points.body: A photo doing something you love says more than a selfie.
points.panel: Add one photo of a hobby, trip, or favorite place.

points.heading: Be specific
points.body: “I love travel” is common. Small details stand out.
points.panel: “Looking for someone to try every taco place in town with me.”

points.heading: Say what you want, kindly
points.panel: “Here for something real, taking it at a comfortable pace.”

points.heading: Keep it warm, not wounded
points.body: Skip the “no drama” and ex references. Focus on what you want.
points.panel: “Kind, curious, and ready for good conversation.”

caption:
Getting back on dating apps after a breakup can feel strange. Your profile doesn’t need to be perfect. It just needs to sound like you.

These five easy upgrades help the right people notice you, and help you feel a little more confident about putting yourself out there again.

Save this before you update your profile, and follow @roundabloom for more.
